stem: A 55-inch and a 65-inch TV model each received 500 units for a 12-week season. The 55-inch model reached 96% sell-through after 3 weeks. The 65-inch model reached 40% after 10 weeks. Which conclusion do these numbers support best?

options.text: The 55-inch model earned more gross margin than the 65-inch
The two models sold about the same number of units a week
The 65-inch model is the stronger candidate for a markdown
The 55-inch model is the stronger candidate for a markdown
